counterfactual_rationale: Record says page_size>1 CUDA-graph KV indices were undersized and create_flashinfer_kv_indices_triton wrote past the buffer on ROCm. A sanitizer, memcheck, initcheck, or racecheck run on the described path would plausibly have exposed it before merge.

Record says speculative draft tokens greater than four under-wrote the DSV4 compression ring and later compression read stale slots. A randomized or edge-case kernel-vs-reference test for that shape or configuration would plausibly have exposed it before merge.
Record only establishes a missing DeepEPMoE Python attribute and does not ground the failure in kernel behavior or dispatch.

Record says a DeepSeek FP4 TP8 launch would hang or fail and was fixed by reverting kernel or quantization commits, but gives little root-cause detail. A the record lacks enough root-cause detail to identify a cheaper specific counterfactual would plausibly have exposed it before merge.

Record fixes ROCm DSv4 FP8 encoding, FP8 byte emission, sparse MLA decode, and gfx942 fallback behavior. A CI lane on the affected hardware, driver, compiler, or dependency matrix would plausibly have exposed it before merge.

Record says a Triton kernel condition was not constexpr, so the None sink pointer branch still reached a tl.load and crashed. A randomized or edge-case kernel-vs-reference test for that shape or configuration would plausibly have exposed it before merge.

Record says CPU rotary embedding computed num_tokens incorrectly and caused a segfault from out-of-bounds access. A sanitizer, memcheck, initcheck, or racecheck run on the described path would plausibly have exposed it before merge.

Record says post_residual_addition was fixed for non-GPU backends after a CUDA-only fix. A CI lane on the affected hardware, driver, compiler, or dependency matrix would plausibly have exposed it before merge.

Record says int32 and int64 indices selected the wrong kvcache kernel and broke CI. A randomized or edge-case kernel-vs-reference test for that shape or configuration would plausibly have exposed it before merge.

Record says FlashInfer SWA and cross-attention dropped fixed_split_size, so deterministic inference drifted across batch shapes. A repeated schedule or batch-composition perturbation test with invariance checks would plausibly have exposed it before merge.
Record attributes Qwen3-VL launch failure to passing an argument to the wrong rotary-embedding class, a model API issue rather than a kernel failure.

Record fixes cache_kernels driver and compiler failures around cuMemcpyBatchAsync on older CUDA drivers and CUDA 13 headers. A CI lane on the affected hardware, driver, compiler, or dependency matrix would plausibly have exposed it before merge.

Record shows XPU external-LB DP streaming output diverged from non-streaming when a process could not see full world_size. A CI lane on the affected hardware, driver, compiler, or dependency matrix would plausibly have exposed it before merge.

Record fixes Blackwell INT4/FP8 MoE checkpoints being routed to a CPU-only INT8 method instead of Humming. A full serving-stack test for the described model and backend would plausibly have exposed it before merge.

Record says the CPU Llama4 MoE path applied router weights at the wrong point relative to MoE calculation. A full serving-stack test for the described model and backend would plausibly have exposed it before merge.

Record says Marlin MoE selected an unsupported kernel for Llama4 apply_router_weight_on_input and raised NotImplementedError. A full serving-stack test for the described model and backend would plausibly have exposed it before merge.

Record fixes CPU kernel compilation on a RISC-V GCC/OpenMP toolchain by explicitly including omp.h. A CI lane on the affected hardware, driver, compiler, or dependency matrix would plausibly have exposed it before merge.

Record adds FP8 block quantization support when N or K is not a multiple of 128 in the CPU MoE path. A randomized or edge-case kernel-vs-reference test for that shape or configuration would plausibly have exposed it before merge.
Record describes an early FlashAttention import breaking a test and does not establish incorrect kernel math, memory behavior, or dispatch.

Record says DeepEP used DP count where EP dispatcher count was required, causing an assertion in DP4TP4. A full serving-stack test for the described model and backend would plausibly have exposed it before merge.

Record says fused KDA verify wrote conv_state while later V tiles could still read it, and output varied with CTA scheduling. A repeated schedule or batch-composition perturbation test with invariance checks would plausibly have exposed it before merge.

Record says ROCm attention backends computed encoder-decoder cross-attention incorrectly and Whisper beam search differed from greedy output. A CI lane on the affected hardware, driver, compiler, or dependency matrix would plausibly have exposed it before merge.

Record says FlashInfer NVLink MoE workspace was sized to the DP group while kernels expected EP group size. A full serving-stack test for the described model and backend would plausibly have exposed it before merge.

Record says mixed activation and RMSNorm weight dtypes let an unsafe fused allreduce-RMSNorm-quant pattern corrupt output. A randomized or edge-case kernel-vs-reference test for that shape or configuration would plausibly have exposed it before merge.

Record shows Cutlass SM90 block-FP8 weight loading failed at runtime with b_scale_group_shape must be 128 by 128. A CI lane on the affected hardware, driver, compiler, or dependency matrix would plausibly have exposed it before merge.
Record only says ROCm W4A4 was routed to emulation instead of AITER and does not establish incorrect output, crash, or severe availability failure.

Record says NixlEPAll2AllManager asserted unless elastic EP created tcp_store_group, blocking standard EP all-to-all use. A full serving-stack test for the described model and backend would plausibly have exposed it before merge.

Record says AMD aiter EAGLE3 non-MLA target_verify used stale indices and hit an MLA-only AttributeError in replay. A full serving-stack test for the described model and backend would plausibly have exposed it before merge.
